name: 60012 · Crystal Lake, IL
findings: ZIP 60012 (Crystal Lake) has 41 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60012 (Crystal Lake) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 60012 (Crystal Lake) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 59% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 22% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
